name: LESET
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $230 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's matching sets and separates in cotton and knit fabrics (tees from $78, trousers about $220–450), sold through its New York and Los Angeles stores, site and Nordstrom.

ownership.owner: LESET, LLC (operating company per site terms)

quote.q: LESET's commitment to comfort and polish wasn't just a trend — it was a shift in how women want to get dressed.

opview: “LESET's commitment to comfort and polish wasn't just a trend — it was a shift in how women want to get dressed.” — LESET (house), About Us, leset.com

facts_read.source: brand site; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: LESET women's clothing and shoes (vendor field holds season codes, all LESET); EXCLUDED: kids, packs, accessories, gift card

doors.note: 2 open (Palisades Village, West Village NYC) + Sunset Blvd West Hollywood coming soon (no date; state not printed, derived CA from ZIP 90069). /pages/stockists exists (wholesale, not counted).

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 8 product types, proportional; 236 styles from 603 records in /collections/all/products.json (accessories, shoes, kids, packs, gi

tech_evidence.names: NONE (fabric sets are house names for sourced cloths — Arielle double-woven crepe, Barb, Rio, Bo 'Technical Taffeta' — sold on hand and drape, not performance)

craft_evidence.owned: no owned facility claimed; 'Made in Los Angeles, CA' on most PDPs, maker not named
craft_evidence.mills: no — the fabric guide gives the fabric's origin by set ('crafted in Japan', 'Fabric made in Italy', 'Fabric Made in France'), but no mill
craft_evidence.madein: 68% (54 of 80 sampled: Los Angeles 53, Italy 1; knitwear and some woven sets state none)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated — 'In 2019, Lili Chemla launched LESET'; stores in Palisades Village, LA and West Village, NYC
craft_evidence.process: partial — a published fabric-set guide gives composition, fabric origin and garment origin for each named fabric family
craft_evidence.reasoning: Most product pages say made in Los Angeles, and the fabric guide gives each named fabric's origin (Japan, Italy, France), which is more than most houses publish. No sewing contractor or mill is named and the brand owns no making, so it's a strong 2; naming the LA makers or the mills would make it a 3.
